0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with Chicago visiting, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance of winning. Chicago is without Isaac Okoro, Nic Claxton, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins, who are all listed as day-to-day, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle, who is also day-to-day with a foot issue. The Raptors beat the Bulls 139-109 in their last meeting on March 18, 2026 in Chicago, and Toronto also won the 2025-26 season series 3-0.
